stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent 3.0.11 Beta fixes a macOS failure in 3.0.10 where a new Playwright driver required an unavailable chromium_headless_shell-1248 executable even though the old browser cache directory existed. The Desktop browser status now checks exact executable/revision or an installed system Google Chrome instead of trusting any old cache folder. Job Agent tries the Playwright-managed browser, then full Playwright Chromium, then installed Google Chrome with the same persistent browser profile for manual application preparation. When every browser is unavailable, SEARCH_ONLY continues scoring HTTP-enriched listings instead of crashing; missing browser evidence remains unverified and cannot make weak vacancies APPLY. Employer forms are not prepared without a working browser. StartupJobs uses the same conservative read-only browser fallback; no CAPTCHA bypass or automatic downloads. No changes to vacancy fit thresholds, candidate information, local submitted history, selected Data/BI vs IT Support/QA CV, Gmail permissions, final manual Submit or search budgets. Offline regression passed 169/169 tests; validate real Mac browser fallback and search-only completion after upgrade.
